units.source_text: 天上撒下点点小雪，使得一路上天空的景色也很艳丽。

en.t: A light snow fell in scattered flakes from the sky, making the view overhead along the road look splendid as well.

units.source_text: 诸亲王、诸公卿中善于鹰猎的人，都预先置备式样新颖的狩猎服装。

en.t: Among the princes and high nobles, those skilled in falconry had all prepared hunting outfits of novel design in advance.

units.source_text: 六卫府中养鹰的官员，其服装更为世人所难得见到：

en.t: The officials of the Six Guards who kept the hawks wore attire even more rarely seen by ordinary people:

units.source_text: 各人各有一种染色的花纹，光怪陆离，异乎寻常。

en.t: each person had a distinct dyed pattern, dazzling and varied, quite out of the ordinary.
